processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The sound portion of the 30 kg vacuum-induction-melted 28Mn5Ni ingot was homogenized at 1423 K for 2.5 h prior to hot rolling.
Hot rolled at 1323 K; the hot rolled (HR) plate final thickness was about 13 mm.

Samples cut from hot-rolled plates were cold rolled to ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets) by several passes. Cold rolling was restricted to 50% for comparison; a further note says cracking was observed beyond 50%.

processing_steps.method: heat treatment (annealing) of cold rolled sheet at 1173 K
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The 50% cold rolled 28Mn5Ni sheet was heat treated at 1173 K for 1 h followed by water quenching; this condition is denoted HR+CR+1173 K.

structures.overall_structure: Partially recrystallized austenitic (γ) matrix in the 28Mn5Ni alloy after 50% cold rolling + 1173 K/1 h + water quench. The microstructure consists of relatively fine, equiaxed recrystallized austenite grains coexisting with retained deformed/strained austenite regions, prior B2 stringers (recovered to bamboo-type morphology) and newly precipitated fine intragranular plus intergranular B2 particles, together with fine intragranular κ-carbides.

phases_present.morphology: relatively fine, equiaxed multi-coloured grains with twin boundaries

phases_present.crystal_structure: perovskite-type (identified via (010)κ satellite spots in SADP)
phases_present.morphology: fine, uniformly distributed intragranular precipitates within recrystallized austenite

precipitates.distribution: fine, uniformly distributed within recrystallized austenite grains

intragranular; its fraction decreased with increasing recrystallized austenite fraction at 1173 K; new B2 precipitates show single-crystal-type orientations with an orientation relationship to adjacent γ grains

microstructure_list.region: deformed/strained regions and prior B2 stringer bands

phases_present.volume_fraction: complement of the recrystallized fraction (predominantly deformed at 1173 K)
~0.1 (near the 0.1 gridline at 1173 K, Fig. 5d); prior B2 in HR condition was ~4% for 28Mn5Ni
phases_present.morphology: prior B2 stringers heavily deformed during cold rolling, fully recovered and developed bamboo-type grain morphology on annealing
coarser intergranular B2 particles decorating grain boundaries

phase_interfaces.coherence: New B2 precipitates displayed single-crystal type orientations and showed an orientation relationship with the adjacent γ-grains (not reported as fully coherent).

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Non-shearable B2 particles act as obstacles to dislocation motion, promoting early initiation of slip band refinement.

interfaces.slip_behavior: Planar slip activity in austenite; dynamic slip band refinement operates in recrystallized/precipitate-poor austenite. Under the HR+CR+1173 K condition, Ni-containing LDS alloys developed inhomogeneous slip band spacing, whereas the Ni-free 28Mn0Ni alloy exhibited homogeneous slip band spacing. Non-shearable B2 particles obstruct dislocation motion.
interfaces.phase_evolution: At 1173 K the prior B2 stringers, heavily deformed during cold rolling, fully recovered and developed bamboo-type grain morphology; new B2 precipitates formed with single-crystal-type orientations showing an orientation relationship with adjacent γ grains. The fraction of intragranular B2 precipitation decreased with increasing recrystallized austenite fraction, indicating that highly strained regions are preferential nucleation sites for these precipitates.
interfaces.interface_notes: Nucleation of recrystallized grains occurred mostly along γ/γ boundaries and γ/B2 interfaces.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: flat tensile specimen, gauge length 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4–5 mm
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Tensile tests conducted at a constant cross-head speed of 0.5 mm min^-1; tests triplicated and average reported.

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Engineering and true stress–strain curves reported (Fig. 9b,c); 28Mn5Ni-1173 K curve overlaps the 15Mn5Ni-1173 K curve, reaching ~1700–1800 MPa.

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Tensile behaviour at HR+CR+1173 K: 28Mn5Ni (YS 900 MPa, UTS 1236 MPa, TE 39%) versus 28Mn0Ni (YS 504 MPa, UTS 905 MPa, TE 86%); 28Mn5Ni retains higher strength and lower ductility, and its strain-hardening exponent (n = 0.30) is lower than that of 28Mn0Ni (n = 0.50).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Zeiss Supra 55 FEG-SEM equipped with EDS and Nordley EBSD detectors (Oxford); step size 120 nm (fine-grained) and 250 nm (coarse-grained) over ~100×100 μm² and ~200×200 μm²; analysed with TSL-OIM software
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Samples polished to colloidal silica ~100 nm surface finish; three scans per sample; Σ3 CSL boundaries used for twin fraction; KAM and GOS (2°) for recrystallization
characterization_methods.purpose: Grain orientations, grain size of recrystallized austenite, twin fraction, phase maps, KAM and GOS to delineate recrystallized microstructure
characterization_methods.key_findings: At HR+CR+1173 K the 28Mn5Ni alloy shows relatively fine, equiaxed recrystallized austenite grains with prominent black B2 stringer bands; recrystallization fraction ~0.4–0.5, grain size of recrystallized austenite of a few μm, twin fraction in the upper 0.2–0.4 interval, and B2 phase volume fraction near 0.1.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Rigaku XRD instrument with Co-Kα radiation at 45 kV and 135 mA, beam size ~2 mm
characterization_methods.purpose: Phase identification (γ, B2, κ-carbide) in cold rolled and heat-treated conditions
characterization_methods.key_findings: For the Ni-containing alloy, κ-carbide and B2 form at 973 K and residual B2 persists to 1173 K (no κ-carbide peaks at 1173 K); the B2 fraction is higher at lower annealing temperature.

characterization_methods.technique: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) with SAED and EDS
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: FEI TECNAI 20T G2 operating at 200 kV equipped with EDAX energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Twin-jet electropolished specimens using mixed acid solution at 243 K (−30 °C)
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify fine phases (κ-carbides, intragranular/intergranular B2), characterize precipitate size/distribution and B2 composition (TEM-EDS)
characterization_methods.key_findings: In 28Mn5Ni at 1173 K the fraction of intragranular B2 precipitation decreased with increasing recrystallized austenite fraction; coarse and fine B2 particle classes observed; B2 (FeAl-based) is enriched in Mn and Ni.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: AFFRI Vickers hardness tester, peak load 30 kg (~300 N), dwell time 15 s
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Per ASTM E-140-02; values averaged over ten measurements per sample
characterization_methods.purpose: Assess hardness change with cold work and heat treatment temperature
characterization_methods.key_findings: Ni-containing alloys (including 28Mn5Ni) were highest in hardness at every heat-treatment temperature and their hardness decreased monotonically with increasing temperature; after heat treatment at 873 K the Ni-containing alloys were ~500 VHN.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Constant cross-head speed 0.5 mm min^-1 (initial strain rate ~3×10^-4 s^-1); flat specimens gauge 30 mm × 6 mm × 4–5 mm; ASTM E8M; triplicated
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate strength and ductility in cold rolled and heat-treated conditions; interrupted tests for substructure evolution
characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn5Ni in HR+CR+1173 K gives YS 900 ± 4 MPa, UTS 1236 ± 5 MPa, TE 39 ± 1%, n = 0.30.

characterization_methods.purpose: Post-tensile fracture surface analysis of failed specimens
characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn5Ni tensile specimens heat treated at 1023 K exhibited dimple morphology, indicating ductile failure.

unmapped_findings: TEM-EDS composition of B2 particles in the 28Mn5Ni alloy at 1173 K (Table 2, Fe balance): Particle-1 – Mn 16.5 wt% (14.9 at%), Al 14.2 wt% (25.7 at%), Ni 26.1 wt% (21.8 at%); Particle-2 – Mn 15.4 wt% (13.7 at%), Al 14.8 wt% (26.7 at%), Ni 27.5 wt% (22.8 at%). B2 is FeAl-based, contains significant Mn and Ni, and becomes enriched in Ni with increasing heat-treatment temperature (block b0042/b0054).

At HR+CR+1173 K, the Ni-containing alloys exhibited nearly identical but relatively lower strain-hardening exponent n (~0.30) compared to 28Mn0Ni (n = 0.50) at the same temperature, indicating lower strain-hardening ability of the Ni-containing LDS (block b0057).

For 28Mn5Ni, the recrystallization fraction at 1173 K (~0.4–0.5) was lower than that of the Ni-free alloy, and no noticeable growth of recrystallized grains occurred in Ni-containing LDS alloys up to 1173 K (Fig. 5a–b; block b0075).

Dual precipitation of intragranular B2, intergranular B2 and κ-carbides together with a partially recrystallized structure gave 28Mn5Ni a better strength (1.3–1.6 GPa) and ductility (17%) combination at 1023 K; at 1173 K there was a substantial drop in strength (block b0081).
